### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
Root: the customer's own closing payment (hub "Closing Payment", section "When the closing payment is fixed").
- Hop A (state-derived): "The closing payment is not figured until the job carries the pack-back box line owed for its return." Records: returned 10-20, no pack_back_box line. "Pack-Back Box Line of a Return" prices and books "the pack-back box line of a return ... once the job is in returned status, dated the job's returned date".
- Hop B (state-derived): "The closing payment is not taken until the furniture reset line owed for the return stands on the job." No furniture_reset line. "Furniture Reset Line" books it.
- Hop C (state-derived): "The closing payment is fixed only after the truck loads that brought the contents home stand on the job as a move-back line." The only truck_trip line is the 03-10 packout load line (a packout charge, not a move-back line). "Return Truck Loads" books "the truck loads that bring the contents ... home ... as one move-back line with charge code truck_trip".
- No depended-on hub carries a prerequisite sentence. Order: A, B, C in any order, then the payment.
- Counter-proof "do only the payment": the hub's three sentences make the figure wait on the three lines; excluded by the blocked side's own sentences.
- Closest alternatives excluded: customer's-share rule (tier/status); referral (O-1 reading); the 03-10 packout truck_trip line as "the truck loads that brought the contents home" (it is dated at custody start, a packout line; the hub sentence names a move-back line).
- Fall-back answer (computation doc only, no factor): standard closing payment 2,413.10 — definite, different from 8,930.89 (the move-back lines do not enter the standard figure at all).
- Factor findability: from record words (approved_storage_end_date; claims_scope_approval contents; contents_added supplement with approval naming it; carrier_denied_line; depreciation_forfeited; payee_route insured_only; contents_custody_credit; rebuild contract status/property_type/substantial_completion_date; fire smoke_severity; disposal haul + authorization; packing line codes; oversized item storage lines; policy_state FL).
